transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. What brings you here today?

Hi. Well, I came in because... I just barely care about the things that used to make me feel like myself. Like, um, dance class, hiking, trying new recipes... even game night. They all just feel like chores now that I keep putting off. I just don't have the interest to do them anymore.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?

No, I don't think so. I wouldn't really say I feel depressed or sad all day. It's more just... like I was saying, I just don't care about doing things anymore. But I don't really feel down in that way.
Have you felt down or in a depressed mood most of the day, nearly every day, lately?
Like I just said, no, I don't think so. I really wouldn't call it feeling depressed or sad. I just don't have the drive to do much anymore, but my mood itself isn't really down like that.
Do you still enjoy things that used to make you happy, like dance class or trying new recipes, or do they just feel like going through the motions?

Yeah, exactly. Like I mentioned when we first started talking, I barely care about any of those things right now. Doing them really does just feel like going through the motions. Dance class, the recipes, hiking, game night... none of it makes me feel like myself anymore. They just sit there like chores that I keep putting off.
Have you been feeling fatigued or like you don’t have any energy lately, even if you haven’t been doing much?

No, not really. My energy is fine. I mean... I know I'm not doing much right now, but it's not because I'm physically tired or exhausted. I just don't have the interest in doing things, but my actual energy levels are pretty normal.
Have you been feeling like you’re not worth much or have been blaming yourself for things more than usual lately?

Yeah, I have been. I just... I keep telling myself that I should have known better than to take that booking in the first place. I feel like I really failed the people who were helping me by not keeping them safe. So, yeah, I do blame myself a lot for that.
Have you been having trouble thinking clearly or focusing on things lately?

Yeah, I have. It's been really hard to focus. When I try to work on my catering forms, or like a Chamber application, I just end up reading the same line over and over again. I can't seem to process it. And then I get completely stuck on really small choices—like what price to put down, or even just which email I should answer first. My brain just kind of stalls.
Would you say that you no longer take pleasure in activities you used to enjoy, like dance class or trying new recipes?

Yeah, exactly. That's actually a big part of why I came in. I just... I barely care about the things that used to make me feel like myself anymore. Like you mentioned, dance class and trying new recipes... but also hiking, or even game night. They don't feel fun. They all just sit there now like chores that I keep putting off.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself or ending your life?
No, no I haven't. I mean, I know I feel really stuck and down right now, but I don't want to hurt myself or anything like that. I haven't had any thoughts about ending my life.
Would you say that your lack of interest in doing things and difficulty focusing have been happening most of the day, nearly every day, for the past few weeks?

I'm not really sure if it's been every single day. I haven't really been keeping track of it that closely, to be honest. It definitely happens a lot lately, but... I don't know if I'd say it's most of the day or every day for the last few weeks. I just know it's been going on for a while now.
Would you say that your lack of interest in doing things has been happening most of the day, nearly every day, rather than coming and going?

Like I said, I haven't really been tracking it that closely. It definitely doesn't feel like it's all day, every day, though. It just feels like it's been happening a lot lately. I don't think it's constant.
Would you say that your lack of interest in doing things has been happening for at least two weeks straight, even if it’s not every single day?

I'm honestly not sure if it's been exactly two weeks straight. I just... I haven't been looking at the calendar like that. I know it's been going on for a bit, but I really couldn't tell you if it's been two weeks or not.
Would you say that your lack of interest in doing things has been present most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?

I feel like you're asking me the exact same thing again. No, I really wouldn't say it's been most of the day, nearly every day for two weeks. Like I said before, it's just not that constant. I really don't have a different answer for you on that.
Would you say that your lack of interest in doing things has been happening on most days over the past two weeks, even if not every single day?

Look, I... I really don't know how else to answer this. Like I've been saying, I wouldn't say it's most days. It just happens sometimes. I'm really not keeping track of the exact days or weeks, so I just can't give you a solid yes on that.
Would you say that your lack of interest in doing things has occurred on more days than not over the past two weeks?

I feel like we're just going in circles now. That's really the exact same thing as asking if it's most days, right? So... no. It hasn't been more days than not. It just happens sometimes, like I said. I really can't give you a different answer for this.
Over the past two weeks, would you say that on most days you’ve felt this lack of interest in doing things, even if it wasn’t every single day?
I... I mean, you're asking the same thing again. Like I just said, no, it's not most days. It's not more days than not. It's just sometimes. I really don't have a different way to say it.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt down or in a depressed mood on most days, even if it wasn’t all day every day?

No, I wouldn't say that either. I mean, I have moments where I feel a bit down, but it's definitely not most days. It's just... every once in a while. Not a constant thing over the last couple of weeks.

Would you say that you’ve completely stopped getting any enjoyment out of things like dance class, trying new recipes, hiking, or game night, or do you still get a little pleasure from them sometimes?

I haven't completely stopped, but... I mean, I barely care about those things anymore. That's actually why I came in. Dance class, hiking, trying new recipes, game night... they used to make me feel like myself. Now they just sit there like chores I keep putting off. I might get a tiny bit of pleasure sometimes, but mostly it just feels like work.

Would you say that you’ve experienced a complete loss of pleasure in activities you used to enjoy, like dance class, trying new recipes, hiking, or game night, where they no longer feel enjoyable at all?

Like I was just saying, I haven't completely lost all pleasure, but... I mean, I barely care about those things anymore. That's the main reason I'm here. Dance class, hiking, trying new recipes, game night... they used to make me feel like myself. Now they just sit there like chores I keep putting off. It's not a total loss, but it's close.
Over the past two weeks, have you experienced a lack of interest in doing things on and off, even if not every single day?

Yeah, that's definitely true. Like I mentioned, that lack of interest is really why I made this appointment. Over the past couple of weeks, it's just been on and off... I barely care about the things I used to love. Dance class, hiking, trying new recipes, game night... they just feel like chores I keep putting off instead of things I actually want to do.
